title: Non-verbal Amazon tribes and their 'ancient language'

tellings.quote: is there's there are apparently nonverbal tribes in the Amazon
In fact, there are Amazonian tribes who they they call it the ancient language and they telepathically beam information to each other

tellings.link_reason: Same Amazonian tribes said to beam information to each other telepathically in an 'ancient language'.

plain: There are said to be tribes in the Amazon who do not speak and instead share information mind to mind, in what they call "the ancient language." Michels tells this himself without naming a source. In one episode, with the documentary maker Ky Dickens on telepathy, he says such tribes "apparently" exist; in a later one he states outright that they "telepathically beam information to each other."
